table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= item.name,
	itempacking.name, 
	printcount=purledger.printcounter, 
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	username=(select username from users where users.usercode=purledger.salesmancode), 
	saleprice=(Case  When ((purledger.purcatcode=7) OR (purledger.purcatcode=8) OR (purledger.purcatcode=3)) 
							then  
								case when (purledger.posted='Y') then
									 purdetail.saleprice/purdetail.packunits
								else
									item.saleprice/item.packunits
								end
					ELSE
							case when (purledger.posted='Y') then
									 purdetail.saleprice
								else
									item.saleprice
								end
					END) ,
	purledger.purinvcode,   
	purledger.date ,
	purledger.posted,  
	purledger.discperc,  
	purledger.misccharges,  
	purledger.flatdisc,  
	purledger.salestax,  
	purledger.suppcode,  
	purdetail.icode,  
	purdetail.batch,  
	purdetail.expiry,
	qty = purdetail.packqty + purdetail.looseqty,  			
	purdetail.bonusqty, 
	purdetail.packunits, 
	purdetail.purprice,   
	purdetail.avgprice,    
	purdetail.discperc,
	purdetail.gstperc,
	purdetail.unitsalestax,
	purledger.invgstperc1,
	purdetail.IDENTITYCOL,
	accounts.aliasname,
	SupplierName=LTRIM(RTRIM(accounts.name)) /*+ ' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(accounts.acccode)) + ')'*/,
	purledger.remarks,
	currqty = (case when posted='N' Then  (select sum(currqty) from godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = item.icode)
				  else
						purdetail.currstock
				  end) / purdetail.packunits, 
	purtype=purchasetype.name	,
	salestax=purdetail.unitsalestax	,
	headerno=purledger.headerno	,
	purledger.suppinvcode,
	purledger.suppinvdate,
	purledger.GRN		,
	remainingdays=datediff(day,getdate(),purdetail.expiry),
	purcategory= case when purcatcode IN (1,2) THEN '(Pack)' when purcatcode=3   THEn   '(Opening)' when purcatcode IN (7,8)   THEn   '(Loose)' END
FROM	
	purledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN purchasetype ON (purledger.purtypecode = purchasetype.purtypecode),
	proformapurdetail purdetail,
	accounts, 
	item 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking ON (item.packcode = itempacking.packcode)
WHERE	
	purledger.impactinventory= 'N' AND
	purledger.purinvcode = :ra_InvCode and 
	purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and 
	purledger.suppcode = accounts.acccode and 
	purdetail.icode = item.icode
ORDER BY 
	item.name

objects.name: c_sumitemnetrate
objects.expression: sum((c_amount *  ( 1 -   purledger_discperc * .01 )  + (unitsalestax * ( qty  +  bonusqty )) +  Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *   gstperc  , 2 ) +( Round((Round( round(c_amount,2)   * (1 -  purledger_discperc * 0.01),2)  -  purledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)) )/ (qty + bonusqty) for all)

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: round(Round((Round(sum( round(c_amount,2)  for all ) * (1 -  purledger_discperc * 0.01),2)  -  purledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)  + sum (c_salestaxval for all),0)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum( round(c_amount,2)  for all ) * (1 -  purledger_discperc * 0.01),2)  -  purledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -   purledger_flatdisc +   purledger_misccharges +  purledger_salestax , 0) + Round(Round((Round(sum( round(c_amount,2)  for all ) * (1 -  purledger_discperc * 0.01),2)  -  purledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)  + sum (c_salestaxval for all),0)
